CustomField.description: Free-text instructions from the Account Manager for the License Ops team, used when preparing renewal quotes. Typical content: invoicing partner, agreed discounts, ELA terms, payment terms, or a link to a Confluence page for complex customers. Requested by the License team
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Instructions for License Ops when quoting for this customer — e.g., invoicing partner, agreed discount, ELA or other special handling. For complex customers, add a link to the relevant Confluence page instead of full details here. Keep it current; License Ops relies on this at quoting time.
CustomField.label: License Instructions
